name: neeley-dress-rehearsal
description: Rehearse a presentation in a custom panel and receive grounded coaching from your Codex conversation.

interface.longDescription: Record or upload a rehearsal, add a script, talking points, transitions or rubric, and ask Codex for a speech rating and annotated transcript. No separate coaching API key. Microphone and local speech processing depend on host support.
defaultPrompt: Open Neeley Dress Rehearsal so I can practice my presentation.
